summary: Iter 93 — Full end-to-end validation of the Auditor Room (create/list/copy/revoke + public read-only + PDF + invalid-token error) AND the universal Standard deep-dive on Agent Inventory, Mission Control, Shadow AI, and Toxicity Map, while regressing the bespoke AgentDetailModal on Delegated Authority Register + Guardrails. Backend pytest (3/3) + Frontend E2E all PASS. Baseline restored (AGT-001 sanctioned, all auditor rooms revoked).
critical_code_review_comments: Delegated Authority Register rows in AuthorityDashboard have no per-row data-testid (e.g., `authority-register-<REF>`). Clicking a row correctly opens the bespoke AgentDetailModal (verified via DOM fallback), but automation currently needs a JS fallback selector. Recommend adding data-testid=`authority-register-${agent.ref}` on the register row buttons for future test stability.

GuardrailsDashboard.jsx: the agent-name <button> that triggers onSelectAgent has no data-testid (e.g., `guardrails-agent-<REF>`). Same recommendation — this would let tests bypass fragile textContent-based selectors.
Auditor Room latest-URL is rendered as <input readOnly>, so tests need `.input_value()` (not `.text_content()`) — worth documenting.
